title: 第3章 至亲之人第4章 召唤本命灵兽
slug: 培养神兽很难我有十只
content_zh:
楚清瑶捂住脑袋，瞪了楚少野一眼：“哥，你可真无趣，我就想要一只漂亮的本命灵兽，以后再契约一只强大的灵兽来保护我不就好了？”
兰芳刚好从厨房里走出来，听到楚清瑶的话发出无情嘲笑。
“呦，还不知道有没有灵主资质就在这说起大话来了，二阶灵主才能够契约第二只灵兽，你只要能当上个一阶灵主，你娘我就烧高香了。”
楚清瑶跺了一下脚，有些生气道：“哼，娘你怎么能瞧不起你自己闺女，我有预感，我肯定能够成为灵主的，还是比爹还厉害的灵主。”
“哦哟，”
兰芳笑道，“我闺女还真是了不得。”
她还想再嘲笑两句，却被楚望山拉了一把。
楚望山笑呵呵道：“我瞧着咱们瑶瑶就挺有灵主的样，不过，就算成不了灵主也没什么，在咱们村里娶妻生子成家立业，平淡幸福的过一辈子也挺好。”
楚清瑶撅起嘴，“我才不要嫁人呢，就咱们村里那些男孩子，连哥的一根手指头都比不上，我才不要嫁给他们。”
兰芳白了她一眼，“你不也是个乡野丫头，还嫌弃起别人来了。”
楚望山笑呵呵的打圆场，“那我们瑶瑶就努力成为一个厉害的灵主，去城里找，总能挑到一个你满意的如意郎君。”
楚清瑶认真思考了一会儿，还是摇了摇头，“还是不要，不管什么人都比不上爹和哥，我才不要嫁。”
楚望山这个老父亲被小棉袄的话哄的浑身舒畅，嘴角忍不住上翘。
兰芳见他的得意样，忍不住笑骂，“别偷着乐了，赶快割一块肉，我还等着做饭呢。”
楚清瑶走过去趴在兰芳的背后，撒娇道：“娘，我想吃辣椒炒猪心。”
兰芳点点她的额头，笑骂，“你这小妮子，就你最会吃。”
听见宝贝闺女的要求，楚望山忙不迭地将猪心割下来扔进兰芳的盆里，转头问楚少野，“儿子，你想吃哪块肉？”
楚少野想了想，“再切点猪肝一起炒吧。”
楚望山道了一声好嘞，手脚麻利地切了块猪肝，一整个猪肝太大，全炒了吃不完。
兰芳端着盆回厨房做饭，楚清瑶蹦蹦跳跳地跟上，“娘，我跟你一起做。”

楚少野则将吃饭用的桌椅板凳，从屋内搬到了院子里，摆放好碗筷。
此时正值春末夏初，白天已经有些暑热，等到了傍晚，又会变得十分凉爽，在院子里吃饭比在屋里舒服。
兰芳手脚麻利，没一会儿就将饭菜做好端了出来，楚望山也将猪肉分解好了，分门别类装了好几盆。
楚少野帮着把肉盆端到厨房里收好，一家人洗净手便开始吃饭。
几颗星子点缀在天边，农家小院满是欢声笑语和饭菜的香味，楚少野嘴角带笑，虽然楚家人和他没有血缘关系，但家人并不只是由血脉决定的。
能够这样和家人在一起，吃一顿家常菜，他觉得这大概就是世界上最幸福的事了吧。
三天的时间转瞬即逝，今天是村里年满十二岁的孩子们，去镇上测定天赋召唤本命灵兽的日子。
一大早兰芳就将两个孩子叫了起来，递给他们一套新衣服。
content_en:
Chu Qingyao covered her head and glared at Chu Shaoye: "Brother, you are so boring. I just want a beautiful spiritual beast. Wouldn't it be nice to contract a powerful spiritual beast to protect me in the future?"
Lan Fang just walked out of the kitchen and laughed mercilessly when she heard Chu Qingyao's words.
"Hey, I'm talking big words here even though I don't know if I have the qualifications of a spiritual master. Only a second-level spiritual master can contract a second spiritual beast. As long as you can become a first-level spiritual master, your mother and I will burn incense."
Chu Qingyao stamped her foot and said angrily: "Humph, mother, how can you look down on your own daughter? I have a hunch that I will definitely become a spirit master, and a more powerful spirit master than dad."
"Oh yo,"
Lan Fang smiled and said, "My daughter is really amazing."
She wanted to laugh a few more words, but Chu Wangshan pulled her back.
Chu Wangshan said with a smile: "I think our Yaoyao looks like a spiritual master. However, even if she can't become a spiritual master, it doesn't matter. She can marry a wife, have children, start a family, and live a peaceful and happy life in our village."
Chu Qingyao pouted, "I don't want to get married. Those boys in our village can't even compare to one of my fingers. I don't want to marry them."
Lan Fang rolled her eyes at her, "Aren't you also a country girl, and you dislike others."
Chu Wangshan reconciled with a smile, "Then we, Yaoyao, will work hard to become a powerful spiritual master. If we go to the city to look for him, we can always find a husband that you are satisfied with."
Chu Qingyao thought seriously for a while, then shook her head, "I still don't want to. No matter who is better than my father and brother, I don't want to marry."
Chu Wangshan, an old father, was soothed by Xiao Mian jacket's words that he couldn't help but turn up the corners of his mouth.
Seeing his proud look, Lan Fang couldn't help laughing and scolding, "Stop enjoying yourself and cut a piece of meat quickly, I'm still waiting to cook."
Chu Qingyao walked over and lay down behind Lan Fang, saying coquettishly: "Mom, I want to eat fried pig heart with chili pepper."
Lan Fang nodded her forehead and scolded her with a smile, "You little girl, you are the best at eating."
Upon hearing his precious daughter's request, Chu Wangshan hurriedly cut off the pig's heart and threw it into Lan Fang's basin. He turned to ask Chu Shaoye, "Son, which piece of meat do you want to eat?"
Chu Shaoye thought for a while, "Let's cut some pork liver and fry it together."
Chu Wangshan said "Okay" and cut into a piece of pork liver with quick hands and feet. The whole pork liver was too big and could not be finished after frying.
Lan Fang carried the basin back to the kitchen to cook. Chu Qingyao jumped up and followed, "Mom, I'll cook with you."
Chu Shaoye moved the tables, chairs and benches used for eating from the house to the yard and placed the bowls and chopsticks.
It's late spring and early summer. It's already a bit hot during the day, but it gets very cool in the evening. It's more comfortable to eat in the yard than in the house.
Lan Fang was quick with her hands and feet, and soon she had the food ready and brought it out. Chu Wangshan also broke down the pork and put it into several pots.
Chu Shaoye helped bring the meat basin to the kitchen and put it away. The family washed their hands and started eating.
A few stars dotted the sky, and the farmyard was filled with laughter and the smell of food. Chu Shaoye smiled. Although the Chu family was not related to him by blood, the family was not just determined by blood.
Being able to be with his family and have a home-cooked meal like this, he thinks this is probably the happiest thing in the world.
Three days passed by in a blink of an eye. Today was the day when the children in the village who were over twelve years old went to the town to determine their talents in summoning their natal spiritual beasts.
Lanfang woke up the two children early in the morning and handed them a new set of clothes.
